request: Expand the monitoring component while preserving the original graph topic and existing components. Add exactly one directly connected responsibility.

base_graph.title: Prototype Model-Serving Stack with Monitoring

nodes.label: Inference Client
nodes.description: Sends prediction requests with user inputs and renders returned model outputs or errors.

nodes.label: Model Serving API
nodes.description: Accepts inference calls, validates request shape, routes to the runtime, and returns predictions within the prototype latency budget.

nodes.label: Model Runtime
nodes.description: Loads the selected model artifact and executes inference for each validated request.

nodes.label: Model Artifact Store
nodes.description: Stores versioned model files and minimal serving config so the runtime can fetch a known artifact.

nodes.label: Serving Log Store
nodes.description: Persists request metadata, outputs or output summaries, errors, latency, and token or cost counters for inspection.

nodes.label: Metrics Monitor
nodes.description: Aggregates TTFT, TPOT, total latency, throughput, error rate, and spend signals from serving telemetry.

nodes.label: Operator Dashboard
nodes.description: Shows current serving health, latency, failures, and cost indicators to a human operator.

nodes.label: Alert Hook
nodes.description: Flags threshold breaches such as error spikes or latency budget misses for prototype review.

assumptions: Prototype maturity overrides the word production: single deployable serving path, no HA, multi-region, canary, drift automation, or CI/CD topology.
Models are self-hosted or locally loaded; no third-party model dependency is required.
Monitoring is read-only: it observes serving behavior and does not mutate models, prompts, rankings, or live configuration.
No external system is mutated; responses are returned only to the requesting client.
Stored model artifacts and request/response logs are retrieved or reused by the serving and monitoring path.

rejected_addition.label: Serving Log Explorer
rejected_addition.description: Queries persisted request, output, error, and latency records from the serving log store so operators can inspect individual inference events behind the aggregate metrics.
